title: Jamaican Jerk Skewers with Flaxseed Crunch
description: A twist on traditional Chinese BBQ, these Jamaican jerk skewers add a Caribbean flavor with a crunchy flaxseed topping.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together flaxseed, allspice, and brown sugar.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, lime juice, and vegetable oil.
4. Thread diced vegetables onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
5. Brush skewers with soy sauce mixture, then sprinkle with flaxseed mixture.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until vegetables are tender.
7. Sprinkle with crushed seedy bread and serve immediately.
